Subject: Private/VPC architecture review - next steps & scheduling

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning - appreciated the deep dive on FinTechCo's planned workload and data residency constraints. Quick recap from our discovery: 

- Primary need: private/VPC deployment for inference serving (data must remain in customer VPC, encryption at rest + transit)
- Expected QPS: 50-200 inference requests/sec with spiky traffic around EOD batch jobs
- Compliance: SOC 2 + logs retention 1 year, KMS integration required
- Timeline: Pilot by end of Q4, production H1 2027

Next step: schedule an architecture review / technical deep dive with our Solutions Engineering team to walk VPC connectivity options, IAM/KMS integration, and deployment topology (on-prem vs cloud VPC patterns). Suggested slots next week:

- Tue 2026-09-08 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-09-09 09:00-10:00 PT

Who from your infra/security team should join? I recommend including anyone who owns network/firewall rules and the person who will manage KMS. I attached a short overview of our Private/VPC offering to give context.

Attached: redwood_private_vpc_overview.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
